info.title: Pontmore Escrow HTTP Service
info.description: Normative wire contract for pontmore_escrow_http_v1. Implements PIP-01 standalone service interface: create, funding_instructions, fund_status, release, refund, cancel. Authentication uses NIP-98 (nostr_http_auth). Funding is two-party (1_of_2 or 2_of_2): amount_sats is the principal contribution required from each participant; release pays the sum of funded contributions, excluding platform fees.

nostr_http_auth.description: NIP-98 HTTP Authentication. Client sends 'Authorization: Nostr <base64 JSON event>' where the event is kind 27235 with tags ['u', '<full request URL>'] and ['method', '<HTTP method>'].

amount_sats.description: Principal contribution in satoshis required from each participant. Both participants contribute the same amount.

idempotency_key.description: Correlation value for request deduplication only; does not authorize participant joining

enrollment_token.description: Single-use, signer-bound token for joining an existing escrow. Join requests require only this field.

funding_model.description: Required two-party funding model. 1_of_2: one of two declared funders must fund. 2_of_2: both funders must fund.

funding_threshold.description: NOT a request field. Fixed by funding_model: 1 for 1_of_2, 2 for 2_of_2. Omit in requests.

participant_count.description: NOT a request field. Always 2 (two-party escrow). Omit in requests.

CreateRequest.description: The creator does not need to know counterparty public keys. The service issues one opaque enrollment token for the counterparty. A joining participant authenticates with NIP-98 and becomes bound to the token at redemption. funding_model must be 1_of_2 (one of two funders must fund) or 2_of_2 (both funders must fund). funding_threshold and participant_count are fixed by the model (2 participants).

funding_threshold.description: Required funded participant count: 1 for 1_of_2, 2 for 2_of_2

enrollment_token.description: Opaque, single-use token. The redeeming NIP-98 signer is bound to it at redemption.

funder_pubkey.description: The funder this invoice belongs to

payment_request.description: BOLT11 invoice the funder(s) must pay

amount_sats.description: Total invoice amount including platform fee

funding_threshold.description: Required funded count to reach active (1 for 1_of_2, 2 for 2_of_2)

my_funded.description: Whether the requesting funder's invoice is paid

funder_status.description: Per-funder invoice state for the requesting participant. Possible values: no_invoice or expired.

signature.description: BIP-340 Schnorr signature over sha256 of the canonical message

recipient.description: Release recipient: creator or counterparty. Refund uses creator because the service returns each funded contribution to its original funder.

payout_sats.description: Released principal: the sum of all funded participant contributions; platform fees are excluded.

refunds.description: Refund results for participant sides funded before cancellation

CanonicalMessage.description: The string each signer signs: pontmore-escrow:v1:<escrow_id>:<action>:<recipient>:<result_hash>:<nonce>:<timestamp>. The signature is BIP-340 Schnorr over sha256(canonical_message).

summary.description: Human-readable dispute summary; evidence should be exchanged privately per PIP-03 disclosure rules.

dispute_opened_by.description: The bound participant pubkey that raised the dispute (identity confirmed via NIP-98).

post.description: Open an escrow and bind the authenticated creator. No participant pubkeys are required at creation. The response issues one opaque, single-use enrollment token per future participant. A join request supplies enrollment_token and the authenticated NIP-98 signer becomes bound to that token and escrow. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated creator and never authorizes enrollment.

200.description: Escrow instance created, or a participant enrolled

post.description: Retrieve the funding instructions (BOLT11 invoice) needed to fund the escrow instance. Idempotent: returns the existing invoice if already generated.

Observe funding and synchronize all issued participant invoices. Funding confirmation moves created to partially_funded, then active once the declared condition is satisfied. Read access remains valid in terminal states.

Request release of the escrowed amount to the recipient. Requires a verified release decision whose format is in the descriptor service.release_decisions. Each signature is a BIP-340 Schnorr signature over sha256(canonical_message).

200.description: Release accepted and payout executed or pending

post.description: Request refund of the escrowed amount to the funder(s). Requires a verified release decision of action 'refund'. Each funded participant receives its contribution back.

200.description: Refund accepted and payout executed or pending

post.description: Cancel a created instance, or cancel a partially_funded instance after funding_deadline. Every funded participant side is refunded before the terminal canceled transition. Active instances require refund with a valid decision.

Raise a dispute on an active or release_pending escrow. The authenticated Nostr pubkey (NIP-98) MUST be a bound participant of the escrow instance; identity is confirmed by the NIP-98 signature over the request URL and payload. Moves the instance to the non-canonical disputed state (documented in x-pontmore-state-machine). The operator resolves the dispute under PIP-03 via /operator/disputes/:id/resolve.

400.description: Validation error (e.g. escrow not active/release_pending, or caller is not a bound participant)

states.created: Canonical. The escrow instance exists with its bound participant pubkeys; no side is funded yet.
states.partially_funded: Canonical. At least one declared participant has funded, but the funding condition is not yet satisfied.
states.active: Canonical. The funding condition is satisfied; release and refund are reachable.
states.release_pending: Canonical. A release or refund request has been submitted and is awaiting an authorizing decision.
states.disputed: Non-canonical operator-added intermediate state (per PIP-01). Reached from active or release_pending when the operator or bounded participant files a dispute. Holds custody while the operator resolves the dispute under PIP-03. Valid operations: fund_status (read), release, refund. funding_instructions and cancel are rejected. Does not relax terminal-state invariants: the only exits are released or refunded.
states.released: Canonical terminal. The escrowed amount has been released to the recipient.
states.refunded: Canonical terminal. The escrowed amount has been refunded to the funder(s).
states.canceled: Canonical terminal. The instance was canceled before becoming active; any partially funded amounts were refunded.

notes: disputed is a non-canonical operator-added intermediate state, documented here as required by PIP-01. It does not relax the terminal-state invariants: once terminal, every mutating operation is rejected with a terminal-state error, and at most one terminal transition may succeed.
cancel is valid in partially_funded only after funding_deadline; funded sides are refunded before the terminal canceled transition.
fund_status remains valid as a read operation in every state, including terminal states.
This service does not implement a split operation; release and refund are the only terminal-triggering participant operations.

x-pontmore-idempotency.description: The idempotency_key in create is scoped to the authenticated creator and deduplicates exact retries. It MUST NOT authorize participant joining. An exact retry returns the existing instance and any still-unredeemed enrollment tokens. Reusing the same key with a different amount, model, threshold, or participant count is rejected and does not mutate the existing instance.

x-pontmore-funding-model.description: Two-party PIP-01 funding. Both declared participants (creator and counterparty) have equal contribution. funding_model is 1_of_2 or 2_of_2. Escrow becomes active when the funding_threshold is met (1 for 1_of_2, 2 for 2_of_2).

1_of_2.description: One of two declared funders must fund. The instance becomes active when either participant's invoice is paid. Release pays the single funded contribution. If both fund, release pays the sum.

2_of_2.description: Both declared funders must fund. The instance becomes active only when both invoices are paid. Release pays 2 * amount_sats.

formats.mutual_consent: Release or refund authorized by all declared participants.
formats.operator_decision: Release or refund authorized by the escrow operator as arbiter.
formats.oracle_signature: Release or refund authorized by a signature from a referenced oracle. The schema MUST name the referenced oracle explicitly and bind the decision to that oracle's public key.
formats.application_signed_result: Release or refund authorized by a signed result from the originating application. The application signer is identified by the signature entry and is not restricted to a preconfigured allowlist. Signed payload MUST include escrow identifier and result identifier/hash; signatures are BIP-340 Schnorr.
formats.threshold_participant_signatures: Release or refund authorized by a threshold of participant signatures. Schema MUST define the threshold value and the location of the participant signatures.
